sloka: असमर्थम् विजानाति धिक् क्षमाम् ईदृशे जने ।स दर्शयति साम्ना मे सागरो रूपमात्मनः ॥६-२१-२१॥।।
transliteration: asamartham vijānāti dhik kṣamām īdṛśe jane ।sa darśayati sāmnā me sāgaro rūpamātmanaḥ ॥6-21-21॥।।

translations.english: "The ocean has not shown his own form to me. O Lakshmana Get the bow and venomous snake like arrows, I will dry up the ocean and the Vanaras can walk by foot and go."
